invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Inverts the effect of the next action.

negate.name: Negate
negate.description: Negates the effect of the next action.

reactive_removal.name: Reactive Removal
reactive_removal.description: Removes an item when receiving damage.

impatience.name: Impatience
impatience.description: Deals increasing damage when you have no items left.

periodic_attack.name: Periodic Attack
periodic_attack.description: Deals damage at the end of each turn.
